questions.question: Who was the first Prophet in Islam?
questions.explanation: Prophet Adam (peace be upon him) was the first human and the first Prophet.

questions.question: Who is the last Prophet in Islam?
questions.explanation: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is the last and final Prophet.

questions.question: Which Prophet built the Kaaba with his son?
questions.explanation: Prophet Ibrahim and his son Ismail built the Kaaba in Mecca.

questions.question: Which Prophet survived the great flood with his Ark?
questions.explanation: Prophet Nuh (Noah) built an Ark and survived the great flood with the believers.

questions.question: Which Prophet was swallowed by a whale?
questions.explanation: Prophet Yunus (Jonah) was swallowed by a whale and prayed to Allah for forgiveness.

questions.question: Which Prophet could talk to animals?
questions.explanation: Prophet Sulaiman (Solomon) was given the ability to understand and communicate with animals.

questions.question: Which Prophet was known for his patience?
questions.explanation: Prophet Ayyub (Job) was known for his incredible patience during hardships.

questions.question: Which Prophet could interpret dreams?
questions.explanation: Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) was blessed with the ability to interpret dreams.

questions.question: Which Prophet parted the Red Sea?
questions.explanation: Prophet Musa (Moses) parted the Red Sea to save his people from Pharaoh.

questions.question: Who was the father of Prophet Ismail?
questions.explanation: Prophet Ibrahim was the father of both Ismail and Ishaq.

questions.question: Which Prophet is known as the 'Friend of Allah' (Khalilullah)?
questions.explanation: Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him) is known as Khalilullah, the close friend of Allah.

questions.question: Which Prophet parted the sea with his staff by Allah's permission?
questions.explanation: Allah parted the sea for Prophet Musa (Moses) and the Children of Israel to escape Pharaoh.

questions.question: Which Prophet was famous for his beautiful dreams and their meanings?
questions.explanation: Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) could explain the meaning of dreams, a special gift from Allah.

questions.question: Which Prophet spoke to people as a baby in the cradle?
questions.explanation: Prophet Isa (Jesus) spoke as a baby to defend his mother Maryam, by Allah's miracle.

questions.question: Who was the mother of Prophet Isa?
questions.explanation: Maryam (Mary) was the righteous mother of Prophet Isa. A whole surah in the Quran is named after her.

questions.question: Which Prophet helped his father Ibrahim build the Kaaba?
questions.explanation: Prophet Ismail helped his father Ibrahim raise the walls of the Kaaba in Mecca.

questions.question: Which Prophet was thrown into a fire that Allah made cool and safe?
questions.explanation: When Prophet Ibrahim was thrown into the fire, Allah commanded it to be cool and safe for him.

questions.question: How long did Prophet Nuh's people have rain and flood?
options: A great flood covered the land
questions.explanation: A great flood covered the land, and only those on Prophet Nuh's Ark were saved.

questions.question: Which Prophet was known for his great patience during sickness?
questions.explanation: Prophet Ayyub (Job) stayed patient and thankful to Allah even when he was very sick.

questions.question: Which Prophet is called the 'Seal of the Prophets'?
questions.explanation: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is the Seal of the Prophets, meaning the last one.

questions.question: Which Prophet's brother was also a Prophet who helped him speak to Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Prophet Harun (Aaron) was the brother of Prophet Musa and helped him deliver Allah's message.

questions.question: Which Prophet was given the Zabur (Psalms)?
questions.explanation: Prophet Dawud (David) was given the holy book called the Zabur.

questions.question: Which Prophet was given the Tawrah (Torah)?
questions.explanation: Prophet Musa (Moses) was given the Tawrah for the Children of Israel.

questions.question: Which Prophet was given the Injil (Gospel)?
questions.explanation: Prophet Isa (Jesus) was given the holy book called the Injil.

questions.question: Which young Prophet defeated the giant Jalut (Goliath)?
questions.explanation: Before becoming a Prophet and king, young Dawud defeated the giant Jalut with a sling.

questions.question: Which Prophet's brothers threw him into a well?
questions.explanation: Prophet Yusuf's jealous brothers threw him into a well, but Allah later raised him to honor in Egypt.

questions.question: Which Prophet was sent to the people of 'Ad?
questions.explanation: Prophet Hud was sent to the strong people of 'Ad who built tall buildings.

questions.question: Which Prophet was sent to the people of Thamud with a she-camel as a sign?
questions.explanation: Prophet Salih was sent to Thamud, and Allah gave them a special she-camel as a miracle.

questions.question: Which Prophet was the father of Prophet Yahya?
questions.explanation: Allah blessed Prophet Zakariyya with his son Yahya when Zakariyya was very old.

questions.question: Which Prophet was swallowed by the whale after leaving his people?
questions.explanation: Prophet Yunus prayed 'La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin' inside the whale, and Allah saved him.

questions.question: How many Prophets are mentioned by name in the Quran?
questions.explanation: 25 Prophets are mentioned by name in the Quran, though Allah sent many more.

questions.question: Which Prophet could understand the speech of ants and birds?
questions.explanation: Prophet Sulaiman heard an ant warning its friends, and he smiled and thanked Allah for His gifts.

questions.question: Which two sons of Prophet Ibrahim became Prophets?
questions.explanation: Prophet Ibrahim's sons Ismail and Ishaq both became Prophets of Allah.

questions.question: Prophet Yaqub was the father of which Prophet?
questions.explanation: Prophet Yaqub (Jacob) was the father of Prophet Yusuf and loved him dearly.

questions.question: Which Prophet was sent to the people of Madyan?
questions.explanation: Prophet Shu'ayb told the people of Madyan to be honest in their buying and selling.

questions.question: What special title was given to Prophet Musa?
questions.explanation: Prophet Musa is called Kalimullah because Allah spoke to him directly at Mount Tur.

questions.question: Which Prophet's people were destroyed while he and his followers were saved in a ship?
questions.explanation: Prophet Nuh preached for a very long time, then Allah saved the believers on the Ark.

questions.question: Which Prophet was raised up to the heavens and will return before the Day of Judgment?
questions.explanation: Muslims believe Allah raised Prophet Isa to the heavens and he will return near the end of time.

questions.question: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is a descendant of which Prophet?
questions.explanation: Prophet Muhammad's family line goes back to Prophet Ismail, the son of Ibrahim.

questions.question: Which of these Prophets is one of the 'Ulul Azm' (Prophets of strong will)?
questions.explanation: The five Prophets of strong will are Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, and Muhammad (peace be upon them all).
